title: Hula 7000 Grape Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Hula 7000 Grape Prefilled pod delivers a rich, fruity flavour with the full sweetness of ripe Grape. Its smooth, rounded profile brings out the deep, jammy notes of the fruit, offering a vape that feels both familiar and satisfying for fans of classic single-fruit flavours. Designed exclusively for the Hula Prefilled Pod System Kit, these replacement pods combine simplicity with performance. Each unit includes a 2ml draw-activated pod that is kept topped up automatically by a built-in 10ml refill reservoir, ensuring you never have to handle messy refills or swap coils. With a total of 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid per unit, expect up to 7000 puffs (approx.) supported by dual mesh coil technology. Just insert the pod into your Hula device and enjoy long-lasting flavour consistency with minimal effort. Available in 20 satisfying flavours, these replacement pods are perfect for keeping your vape fresh and flavourful.
